memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria, atrial fibrillation, and gastro‑oesophageal reflux disease.
Patient reports occasional itchy wheals lasting <24 h, palpitations on exertion, and post‑meal heartburn. Exam shows mild urticarial lesions on arms, regular rhythm with irregular pulse, no abdominal tenderness. Spirometry: FEV1 3.2 L (95% pred), FVC 3.8 L, FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 since prior N/A. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
- Levocetirizine 5 mg OD – ongoing
- Apixaban 5 mg BD – ongoing
- Bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD – ongoing
- Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast – ongoing
- Domperidone 10 mg BD before meals – ongoing

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2×10⁹/L (4‑10), Neutrophils 4.5×10⁹/L, Lymphocytes 1.2×10⁹/L, Eosinophils 0.3×10⁹/L (0.0‑0.5), Platelets 210×10⁹/L (150‑400).
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0).
Serum creatinine 0.92 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: 12‑lead ECG: Irregularly irregular rhythm with absent P waves, ventricular rate 78 bpm, consistent with atrial fibrillation. No acute ST‑T changes. QRS duration 92 ms. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits.

memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025‑07‑10 at 10:00 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).
